scheme_name: Scheme for Assistance on Purchase of Smartphone by the Farmers
other_conditions: Assistance is limited to one per tenant farmer even if multiple accounts exist.
In case of joint account, only one of the tenants mentioned in 8-A of their land is eligible.
benefits_summary: Provides up to 40% assistance on the purchase price of a smartphone, up to ₹6,000, available only once per applicant.
